Additional: student service fee per semester (odd Rs 3,950 boys / 3,730 girls; even Rs 3,500 / 3,280), one-time alumni fee Rs 500, refundable caution money Rs 4,000; hostel and central library fee separate. selectionProcess.name: CUET (PG) score (NTA), paper COQP12
selectionProcess.detail: Candidates must have appeared in CUET (PG); registration for DAVV counselling at davv.mponline.gov.in (Rs 1,500 + Rs 100 portal charges; 2026 deadline was 10 Jun 2026). Eligibility: graduation in any stream with min. 50% (5% relaxation for MP-domicile SC/ST/OBC-NCL and PwD).

selectionProcess.name: DAVV counselling on CUET (PG) merit
selectionProcess.detail: Merit list prepared solely on the CUET (PG) score in the selected test paper; ties broken by age (older ranks higher). Choice filling, allotment and document verification over first and second counselling rounds.

keyDates.notes: 2026-27 cycle: DAVV counselling registration closed 10 Jun 2026 (NRI/foreign 12 Jun 2026). Dates for 2027-28 (CUET PG 2027) not published as of 2026-11-12.

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; 101-125 band not checked
